meta.title: GeomSoft Shapes — launch keynote, 1 December 2026
meta.description: Launch keynote for GeomSoft Shapes, a habit app that logs each day as a shape: the streak-guilt problem, three features, beta proof, price and availability.

slides.heading: Build habits with shapes, not guilt.
slides.lead: GeomSoft Shapes arrives on iOS today.
slides.notes: Hold the line for a beat. The whole talk proves one word: guilt.

slides.quote: I quit three habit apps because one missed day reset my streak to zero.

slides.heading: One shape a day for each habit you care about
slides.lead: Circles for done. Halves for partly. Outlines for rest days.

slides.heading: How it works
slides.lead: Three loops. One minute a day.

slides.heading: A daily check-in takes one tap and eight seconds
slides.body: One question per habit. Tap full, half or rest. No typing, no timers.
slides.image: data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 900 900'><rect width='900' height='900' fill='%23b8cddd'/><rect x='120' y='150' width='660' height='600' rx='40' fill='%23faf9f7'/><text x='180' y='250' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='26' fill='%23455e51'>Tuesday · Stretch</text><text x='180' y='310' font-family='sans-serif' font-weight='700' font-size='40' fill='%231a1a1a'>Did you stretch today?</text><circle cx='260' cy='480' r='80' fill='%23f0b4d4'/><path d='M450 400 A80 80 0 0 0 450 560 Z' fill='%23f0b4d4'/><circle cx='450' cy='480' r='78' fill='none' stroke='%23f0b4d4' stroke-width='4'/><circle cx='640' cy='480' r='78' fill='none' stroke='%23f0b4d4' stroke-width='4' stroke-dasharray='10 10'/><g font-family='sans-serif' font-size='24' fill='%231a1a1a' text-anchor='middle'><text x='260' y='610'>Done</text><text x='450' y='610'>Partly</text><text x='640' y='610'>Rest day</text></g><text x='450' y='700' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='20' fill='%23455e51' text-anchor='middle'>Median check-in: 8 seconds</text></svg>

slides.heading: Your month reads as a pattern you can scan in a second
slides.lead: Gaps show up as outlines, so you see a rhythm, not a failure.
slides.imageAlt: Month view: four rows of pastel shapes, one per day, with a few outlined shapes marking rest days.

slides.heading: A missed day bends your pattern instead of breaking a streak
slides.body: A skipped day draws an outline, and your 40-day pattern stays. Streak resets drive 31% of churn (exit survey, n = 610).

slides.imageAlt: Comparison: another app shows a 0 day streak after one miss; Shapes shows a row of circles with one outline and 40 of 41 days kept.

slides.heading: 72% of beta users still checked in after 30 days
slides.notes: Compare 72 with 8 out loud. That gap is the launch.

slides.quote: It is the first habit app my patients still open after the second appointment.

slides.heading: Shapes is free, and Plus costs $3.99 a month
From today, your habits bend instead of break.
slides.lead: Waitlist members get one month of Plus free.
